panels.title: Overall Capacity State
panels.description: Executive decision summary. Missing data means the selected range has no capacity evidence, not that the estate is OK.

targets.rawSql: select OverallRisk from RiskAssessment order by case OverallRisk when 'Critical' then 3 when 'Warning' then 2 when 'OK' then 1 else 0 end desc, CalculatedAt desc limit 1

panels.title: Top 5 Capacity Risks
panels.description: Top 5 services or resources that need executive prioritization.

targets.rawSql: select ScopeId, OverallRisk, Reason, CalculatedAt from RiskAssessment where OverallRisk in ('Warning','Critical') order by case OverallRisk when 'Critical' then 2 when 'Warning' then 1 else 0 end desc, CalculatedAt desc limit 5

panels.title: Capacity Used Vs Headroom
panels.description: Decision view of used capacity and remaining headroom. Missing data means no KPI evidence for the selected range.

targets.rawSql: select ResourceId, MetricName, AverageUtilization as UsedPercent, PeakUtilization, P95Utilization, HeadroomAvailable as AvailablePercent from CapacityKpi order by HeadroomAvailable asc, CalculatedAt desc limit 10

panels.title: Forecast 30/60/90 Days
panels.description: Forecast windows and days-to-saturation for investment and remediation decisions.

targets.rawSql: select ResourceId, MetricName, Forecast30Days, Forecast60Days, Forecast90Days, DaysToSaturation, Confidence from ForecastResult order by DaysToSaturation asc, CalculatedAt desc limit 20

panels.title: Recommendations
panels.description: Prioritized recommended actions. Missing data means no open recommendation exists for the selected scope.

targets.rawSql: select Priority, Action, Reason, Status from Recommendation where Status = 'Open' order by case Priority when 'High' then 3 when 'Medium' then 2 when 'Low' then 1 else 0 end desc limit 20

panels.title: Monthly Growth And Baseline
panels.description: Executive trend context for growth and deviation from baseline.

targets.rawSql: select ResourceId, MetricName, MonthlyGrowthRate, BaselineDelta, HeadroomAvailable from CapacityKpi order by MonthlyGrowthRate desc, CalculatedAt desc limit 20
